one_line_reason: Both shortlisted PMIDs are human CYP450 pharmacokinetic/interaction studies, not efficacy trials for any consumer health outcome.
blockers: No efficacy outcome studied in the shortlist; both records measure CYP450 enzyme activity, which is a pharmacokinetic/interaction endpoint, not an outcome people buy goldenseal for.

handoff_pmids.note: RCT in 16 healthy volunteers; goldenseal supplementation for 14 days significantly inhibited CYP3A activity (via midazolam probe), suggesting herb-drug interaction risk with CYP3A substrates.
RCT in 12 healthy volunteers; goldenseal for 28 days significantly inhibited CYP2D6 (~40%) and CYP3A4/5 (~40%) activity via phenotypic probe drugs, indicating herb-drug interaction risk.
